title: Eureka! McConnell Science Museum

services.name: Admission
services.desc: Step into the dark and phosphorescent geology cave, land a space shuttle, and learn about our local water system. Discover dozens of fascinating exhibits, from physics and bubbles, to a gyroscopic chair and a colorful fish tanks. Ready to visit? We look forward to exploring with you - See you soon! As a Friend of EUREKA!, your reliable support powers everything we do. Enjoy member-only perks while sustaining the future of E!. For information about parking, how long to visit, and more, check our Frequently Asked Questions
